name: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8

display.notes: External/module-dependent in general; KryonOS v3 config: 240x320 ILI9341 SPI. Live display needs-runtime-host; pins differ from es3c28p compiled host.

touch_input.notes: XPT2046 SPI/bitbang model not implemented in current host (matrix: needs-runtime-host). DevKit is generic; exact module may vary.

audio.notes: No dedicated board audio/I2S pins in KryonOS v3 env flags shown; conditional(version/tool).

storage.flash_fs: Partition layout per firmware (KryonOS v3 split @0x0/0x8000/0x10000; FS depends on build)
storage.sd: SD via FileSystem::mountSD() abstraction (KryonOS v3; exact pins not in env flags)
storage.sd_emulation: conditional(version/tool): esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd (ESP32-S3 SDMMC); board wiring not verified
storage.notes: SD card: esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd only; this board wiring is not verified.

local.notes: No dedicated local emu env defined for this board in repo docs; use custom or build as applicable.

kryonos_v3.notes: Release split assets (bootloader/partitions/firmware @0x0/0x8000/0x10000). No ELF in release.

pins.notes: Pins from KryonOS v3.0.0 prep (platformio/HAL). DevKit hardware may vary; confirm for specific module.

notes: KryonOS v3 global: ESP32-S3 240MHz, 16MB flash qio, qio_opi/OPI PSRAM, USB CDC on boot.
Release binaries lack emu guards (ESP_EMU_SKIP_AUDIO-style); boot may WDT/hang on I2S/SD/ADC.
Best first candidate for serial boot experiments (prep doc).
